rationale: THE CONTROL for module-leaf-declaration-file.d (VERIFY_TS10). Leaf identity is `basename` minus the LAST extension: `dotfile-stem.module.config.ts` publishes `dotfile-stem.module.config`. Only a DECLARATION file's `.d` is part of the extension rather than of the name. The NAME is the assertion and it had to be chosen to make the two rules distinguishable — the first version of this fixture was `module-leaf-dotfile-stem.ts`, whose only dots belong to the extension, so a mutant cutting at the FIRST dot returned the identical string and this control passed under it (measured: the mutant run reported 93 pass / 0 fail with the control still green). A control that cannot tell the two rules apart is not a control.

expectRelationships.note: the leaf keeps every interior dot: basename minus the LAST extension
CONTROL: the call edge names the module too and is affected the same way

forbidRelationships.note: over-stripping: cutting at the FIRST dot would name the module `dotfile-stem`
